title: Use a Sankey to show money into one account and out of it.
rule: Draw each source as a band from the left into one node and each use as a band from the node to the right, every band as wide as its amount in one linear unit, with a key band, so the bands sum at the node. Put the money on hand at the start first on the left and at the end last on the right, so the node balances, and give any remainder the record leaves in a note. Group loans and their repayments apart by a gap under their own names, so a reader can tell a loan from a gift, and say in a note that no dollar received is traced to a dollar spent. The flow the title names takes the text’s ink; the rest are gray with a thin edge (Rule 14.6).
use_when: The reader asks where an account’s money came from and where it went, in one period.

use_instead.when: Money sent from a few senders to receivers
Lines that add and subtract to a total
Parts of one total in one year

text: Bands on one scale show the largest sources and uses at a glance and keep the account’s balance in view. Small lines shrink to a hairline at that scale, so each band prints its amount and the table keeps every cent.
why.basis: Design judgment, from the chart system our founder and editor approved in November 2026

builders: Form sankey: node work/build/chart-kit/oa-chart.mjs build s76; encode side, key, category and value; labels.groups sets bands apart under a name, labels.track the cash on hand, labels.named the flow in the subject ink, labels.open lets the node keep the record’s remainder; draws through K.parts.flows, flow_band and width_key.
